title: FrozenTeams
body:
![The Team GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/642f6fcf83b03c6352cf1c3b5d1d64b25132663c_0.webp) # ❄️ FrozenTeams The modern, feature-rich Teams plugin for Paper & Folia servers. «Create teams. Build communities. Play together.» --- 🌟 Why FrozenTeams? FrozenTeams is a modern Teams plugin built for servers that want a clean, intuitive, and highly configurable team system without unnecessary complexity. Whether you're running a Survival, SMP, Lifesteal, RPG, or Adventure server, FrozenTeams gives your players everything they need to create and manage teams effortlessly. Designed with performance, customization, and Folia compatibility from the ground up. --- ✨ Features 👥 Advanced Team Management ✔ Create unlimited teams ✔ Invite players ✔ Accept or deny invitations ✔ Leave teams ✔ Kick members ✔ Transfer ownership ✔ Delete teams ✔ Team information menu ✔ Configurable maximum team size ✔ Configurable team name limits ✔ Block inappropriate team names --- 🏠 Team Home Give every team its own shared home. Features - Set a team home - Teleport to your team's home - Configurable teleport delay - Perfect for Survival & SMP servers --- 💬 Private Team Chat Communicate privately with your teammates. Commands /teammsg /tc /teamchat No global chat spam. Only your teammates can see your messages. --- 🖥 Beautiful GUI FrozenTeams includes modern inventory GUIs that make team management simple. Current GUIs include: - Main Team Menu - Manage Members Menu Everything is configurable. --- ⚙ Highly Configurable Customize almost everything. Storage - YAML - MySQL Supports cross-server setups using MySQL. --- Team Settings Configure: - Maximum members - Team name length - Invite expiration - Teleport delay - Banned team names - Chat input system --- ⚡ Performance Designed to be lightweight. ✔ Optimized code ✔ Async-friendly storage ✔ Minimal performance impact ✔ Folia Support --- 🔌 PlaceholderAPI Support Available placeholders: Placeholder| Description "%frozenteams_team%"| Team name "%frozenteams_leader%"| Team leader "%frozenteams_members%"| Total members "%frozenteams_max_members%"| Maximum members "%frozenteams_home%"| Team home "%frozenteams_pvp%"| PvP status "%frozenteams_role%"| Player role --- 🛠 Commands Player Commands Command| Description "/team"| Main team command "/team create"| Create a team "/team invite"| Invite a player "/team join"| Join a team "/team leave"| Leave your team "/team kick"| Kick a member "/team delete"| Delete your team "/team info"| View team information "/team sethome"| Set team home "/team home"| Teleport home "/team transfer"| Transfer ownership "/team msg"| Team chat --- Admin Commands Command| Description "/teamadmin reload"| Reload configuration "/teamadmin delete"| Delete a team "/teamadmin info"| Team information "/teamadmin list"| List all teams --- 🔑 Permissions Permission| Description "frozenteams.use"| Use team commands "frozenteams.create"| Create teams "frozenteams.admin"| Admin commands "frozenteams.bypass"| Bypass restrictions --- 📦 Compatibility Software| Supported Paper| ✅ Folia| ✅ Purpur| ✅ Pufferfish| ✅ Minecraft Version 1.21+ --- 📁 Storage Choose the storage that fits your server. ✔ YAML ✔ MySQL Switch to MySQL for cross-server synchronization. --- ❤️ Perfect For - SMP Servers - Lifesteal - Survival - RPG - Adventure - Economy Servers - Community Servers --- 📸 Screenshots «Replace these with your own screenshots.» - Main GUI - Team Creation - Manage Members - Team Home - Team Chat --- ❓ Frequently Asked Questions
Does FrozenTeams support Folia?Yes! FrozenTeams is fully compatible with Folia.
Can I use MySQL?Absolutely. Both YAML and MySQL are supported.
Is PlaceholderAPI required?No. PlaceholderAPI is optional and only required if you want placeholders.
Can I customize the GUIs?Yes. The GUI layouts are fully configurable.
--- 🚀 Why Choose FrozenTeams? ✅ Lightweight ✅ Modern GUI ✅ Folia Support ✅ MySQL Support ✅ PlaceholderAPI Integration ✅ Configurable ✅ Performance Friendly ✅ Clean User Experience --- ❤️ Developed by FrozenStudio Thank you for choosing FrozenTeams! If you enjoy this plugin, consider leaving a ⭐ on the project page. Your support helps improve the plugin and keeps new updates coming!
